characterDesign: Self-authored sunshine-dragon design attempt; rounded baby face with balanced eyes, retained small crest and no nostrils; orange-unified adult with a swept forehead-to-nape mohawk; generic cute-to-mature growth contrast only
gait: bipedal; hind legs support weight, forelimbs are raised FK arms
motionOwner: src/locomotion.ts; GLB Root has no accumulated translation or yaw
feedingReview: Two eating and four joy performances retained; arm/neck source geometry and anatomical weights corrected at user request. Mouth baseline independently regenerated before carving on the corrected body; artistic review pending.
feedingSelection: Eight combinations per resident; no repeat of the last two base joys; every fifth eaten fruit adds a second joy without extra count; page-memory only

mouth.geometry: Real concave cavity in the skin, warm dark interior and inset skinned tongue; no overlay mouth plane
mouth.construction: Neutral slit and sealed pocket; no exterior compression or lip bevel. Original exterior normals retained, rim weights blended continuously, and tongue keeps rounded volume.
mouth.regression: Original-surface shading and triangle orientation checked inside the patch, including sampled eating/joy poses; visual multi-angle inspection is still required.
mouth.rig: Existing Jaw; upper smile pinned to Head; MouthSocket follows aperture midpoint

states.receivingAndCheering: Wider C opening; JoyCheer uses full range

WingOpen.end: open authored bind; clamp at endpoint

WingClose.end: shoulder rearward 65 degrees; elbow fan yaw 83 and roll -65 degrees

final.bindPose: open wings; first displayed pose is IdleBreath at 0 seconds

contacts.arms: Forelimbs use raised counter-swinging FK, not ground IK
contacts.limitation: Selected marker and finite surface samples do not certify every frame, blend or visual naturalness.

shoulderRepair.construction: Front limb roots reach back into the chest rather than up into the head. Sun arm joints lowered onto the torso sides; night adult lower head lobe clears the shoulder. Source-part surface regions blend limb-only and head-only weights continuously.
shoulderRepair.clearance: At least 2.5 authoring voxels between front-limb and head source surfaces before voxel union.
shoulderRepair.regression: Exported outer-sleeve samples limit head/neck influence; full geometry audits and close-up pose sheets are separate evidence.
shoulderRepair.review: Human visual review pending; no new artistic approval implied.
